description:
Get billing operation

Returns the authoritative state of a billing operation belonging to the selected project. Use it to recover or poll a plan-change request until the operation reaches success or failure. An accepted request is not evidence that the plan change has completed.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/project-billing/get-billing-operation

operationId.description: Operation id returned by a purchase or quantity change.

A payment the customer's bank asked them to authenticate (3DS). The invoice's pay route completes it.

amountCents.description: Amount of the payment, in cents.

expiresAt.description: When the operation stops waiting: past it, the payment is cancelled and the operation fails. Null without an operation.

invoiceId.description: The invoice whose payment it is. Pay it to complete the payment.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice's number. Null until the invoice is issued: a plan change is invoiced once it is paid.

operation.description: The pending operation it completes. Null for an invoice no operation waits on, such as a renewal.

subjects.description: What it pays for: the operation's project or organization, or those the invoice bills.
